_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/clock-date.reason: the layout follows HA line by line (Blink's line boxes put the AM exactly on HA's; the tablet matches). Left at 1.5x: whole-pixel text boxes. The digits, the AM and the date are TextViews as wide as their text rounded up, so the AM sits 1.5 device px right and the resting date ~1.8 px right; the date is 1 px low because Vitro boxes it at the font's normal height (28.67 px) where ha-marquee-text's middle-aligned inline-block makes 27.84. Boxing it that way was tried (2026-11-24): the column, 1 px shorter, moved the clock's whole-pixel centering a pixel the wrong way, 3.65 %

mirror/history-graph-rows.reason: the chart shrinks to its 5-row slot as HA's does (chart and legend at the same heights, bounds 0). Left: the y-axis width drift of history-graph-two (the capture host's Chrome measures the labels in its fallback font, Vitro in Roboto), so every point sits ~2 px left (2026-11-24)

mirror/history-graph-timeline.reason: the bars match HA's half-covered edges (the chart is drawn half a pixel off the grid as HA's canvas is composited; the tablet matches). Left at 1.5x: the name and time labels, ECharts' canvas text, blended across two rows in HA and snapped to whole rows by Skia in Vitro (1 px low or right), as in history-graph-two: 2.04 % against the 2 % line (2026-11-24)

mirror/history-graph-two.reason: the chart's geometry matches HA's at every density (ECharts 6's outer bounds, Blink's header and legend lines; the tablet matches). Left at 1.5x: ECharts' canvas text. HA composites the chart's canvas where its box falls (17, 57.8 CSS px: a fraction of a device pixel off the grid), so its axis labels come out blended across two rows; Vitro draws the chart half a pixel off too (CardSurface.contentSubpixel) but Skia snaps the glyphs to whole rows, and the value and time labels sit 1 px right or low. Placing the canvas at its exact HA origin didn't help, and made the tablet worse (2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod-has.reason: the sheet applies as in HA (:host centering, ha-card:has() tint, green heading, 18 px bold paragraph; the tablet matches). Left at 1.5x: whole device px. Each Markdown block is a TextView whose line box rounds on its own (the h3's 28.5 px to 29, the paragraphs' 43.2 to 43 and 33.6 to 34), where Chrome rounds positions, so the card comes out 0.5 CSS px taller and its 2 px bottom border a row lower, and the 16.38 px h3 draws at 16.67 (AbsoluteSizeSpan; fractional sizes tried earlier: no pixel gain). The report's +5.5 px on "text." is not Vitro: HA's run box starts at the space before it (2026-11-24)
